svg.aria-label: Padding vs packing for the same 64 TinyAgent episodes
svg.text: Padding vs packing for the same 64 TinyAgent episodes
Equal area = equal compute. Padded: 64 x 149 = 9,536 positions; packed: 10 x 256 = 2,560; real tokens: 2,472.
Dark ticks mark sequence boundaries. Each sequence restarts its
position ids at 0 and attends only within its own block.
